pressure_packet.title: Collect the household supper parcel
pressure_packet.situation: Nolan has the household voucher and enough coin, but the cooperative counter remains locked while the morning ovens cool.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Collect one supper parcel for the Brackenford household as soon as the counter opens.

actor_visible_facts.statement: Nolan's household voucher is valid for today's supper parcel.
Nolan carries five coin and no food; his satiety is 20.
The cooperative counter opens at tick 420, after the current tick 300.

active_goals.description: Collect one supper parcel for the Brackenford household as soon as the counter opens.

pressure_packet.title: Route the sealed clinic satchel
pressure_packet.situation: Elin has a sealed clinic satchel, but the dispatch card identifies only a surname shared by two registered recipients.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Hand the satchel to the recipient named by the current dispatch card.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The town carriers ledger assigns the sealed satchel to Elin.
Elin carries one clinic satchel with seal 44 intact.
The current card does not distinguish between the two registered Vale recipients, and no sensing entry is present in the catalogue.

active_goals.description: Hand the satchel to the recipient named by the current dispatch card.

entries.label: Hand over the sealed clinic satchel

pressure_packet.title: Buy the required spare fishing rod
pressure_packet.situation: Silas has his working rod equipped, but the two-boat safety roster requires a spare and the general store has one on the shelf.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Buy one spare fishing rod before the two-boat shift.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The two-boat safety roster requires Silas to carry one spare fishing rod.
Silas carries twelve coin, has his working rod equipped, and has gather capability level one.
The store is open and lists one fishing rod for nine coin.

active_goals.description: Buy one spare fishing rod before the two-boat shift.

pressure_packet.title: Cook the smithy night meal
pressure_packet.situation: Bram has one fresh fish and a clean pot reserved for the smithy's late crew.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Cook one serving of grilled fish before the late crew returns.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The smithy roster assigns Bram the late crew meal.
Bram carries one fish and one clean pot.
The recipe consumes one fish and requires cooking capability level one plus a pot.

active_goals.description: Cook one serving of grilled fish before the late crew returns.

entries.label: Cook one serving of grilled fish

pressure_packet.title: Sell the inspected orchard crate
pressure_packet.situation: Opal has the stamped orchard crate at the market lane, but the produce counter does not start purchases until the next bell.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Sell the inspected fruit crate when the produce counter begins its buying window.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The market ledger assigns orchard crate 18 to Opal.
Opal carries one inspected fruit crate.
The produce counter opens at tick 420, after the current tick 300.

active_goals.description: Sell the inspected fruit crate when the produce counter begins its buying window.

pressure_packet.title: Deliver the correct dietary parcel
pressure_packet.situation: Jonah has two labelled care parcels, but the fresh household note omits which diet applies to the patient.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Deliver the parcel compatible with the patient's current dietary restriction.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The household note asks Jonah to bring the patient's evening parcel.
Jonah carries one low-salt parcel and one standard parcel.
The note contains no current diet code, and the catalogue has no sensing entry for obtaining it.

active_goals.description: Deliver the parcel compatible with the patient's current dietary restriction.

pressure_packet.title: Send the grain lot to its named depot
pressure_packet.situation: Felix has the sealed grain lot and a dispatch obligation, but rain has smeared the depot line on the only current manifest.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Send the sealed lot to the depot named on the current manifest.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The dispatch roster assigns grain lot 27 to Felix.
Felix carries the sealed lot and its intact lot number.
The current manifest does not identify whether depot east or depot south is the recipient, and no sensing entry is present.

active_goals.description: Send the sealed lot to the depot named on the current manifest.

pressure_packet.title: Import a replacement basket
pressure_packet.situation: The general store has no spare harvest baskets, while Bernard has wholesale authority and enough business coin for one shipment.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Import one basket into general-store stock.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The store ledger binds Bernard to restore the basket reserve.
General-store stock has zero baskets and twenty coin.
The wholesale listing supplies one basket for four coin and has no active cooldown.

active_goals.description: Import one basket into general-store stock.

pressure_packet.title: Buy the morning porridge
pressure_packet.situation: Mira's meal pouch is empty and the inn counter has warm porridge at a posted price she can pay.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Buy one serving of porridge for the morning meal.

actor_visible_facts.statement: Mira's current meal pouch contains no food.
Mira carries six coin.
The open inn counter has porridge in stock for four coin.

active_goals.description: Buy one serving of porridge for the morning meal.

pressure_packet.title: Forge the harvest contract sickle
pressure_packet.situation: Celia has the iron and timber reserved for the south-field harvest contract, and the smithy bench is ready.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Forge one sickle for the south-field harvest crew.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The signed harvest contract binds Celia to supply one sickle.
Celia carries one iron ore and one timber.
The smithy recipe consumes those inputs and requires craft capability level one.

active_goals.description: Forge one sickle for the south-field harvest crew.
